encounters.cc: Brought to the emergency department by her sister due to erratic behavior, auditory hallucinations, and delusions that the government is broadcasting her thoughts.

lines: Brought to the emergency department by her sister due to erratic behavior, auditory hallucinations, and delusions that the government is broadcasting her thoughts.
She believes that she is a prophet and that the government is broadcasting her thoughts on the radio.
She is visibly distressed, pacing back and forth, and appears to be responding to internal stimuli.
The patient has a history of schizophrenia but has been non-compliant with her medications for the past 6 months.
- Emtricitabine/Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate 200 mg/300 mg PO daily
Smoking: Former smoker, quit 3 years ago.
Vital signs are within normal limits.
On examination, she is disheveled, has poor eye contact, and her speech is disorganized.
She is oriented to person but not to place or time.
- Complete blood count: within normal limits

encounters.cc: Presents with lethargy, dizziness, and worsening hopelessness after stopping antidepressant medication.

lines: Presents with lethargy, dizziness, and worsening hopelessness after stopping antidepressant medication.

This 32-year-old patient with schizophrenia, major depressive disorder, HIV infection, epilepsy, Graves' disease, and hypertension returns to the emergency department two months following her initial presentation for auditory hallucinations and delusions.
She reports feeling increasingly hopeless over the past few weeks and has stopped taking her antidepressant medication.
She denies current suicidal ideation but admits to having had such thoughts up until a week ago.
Her roommate, who accompanied her, expresses concern about the patient's recent withdrawal from social activities and increased alcohol consumption.
She has a history of major depressive disorder and was hospitalized two years ago following a suicide attempt by overdose.
- Emtricitabine/Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate 200 mg/300 mg PO daily
Smoking: Former smoker, quit 3 years ago.
The patient's vital signs are stable
- Urine toxicology screen: Positive for ethanol

encounters.cc: Palpitations, shortness of breath, and fever of 39.2°C following several months of medication noncompliance.

lines: Palpitations, shortness of breath, and fever of 39.2°C following several months of medication noncompliance.
The patient is a 32-year-old female with Graves disease and psychiatric history who returns following prior encounters.
She admits to medication noncompliance for several months and recently underwent a dental extraction due to an abscessed tooth.
- Major depressive disorder with psychotic features (diagnosed 2020-03-15)
She has a history of Graves' disease.
- Emtricitabine/Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate 200 mg/300 mg PO daily
Smoking: Former smoker, quit 3 years ago.
Her heart rate is 132 beats per minute, blood pressure is 150/95 mmHg, and respiratory rate is 28 breaths per minute.
On examination, she is agitated, diaphoretic, and appears ill.
An irregularly irregular rhythm is noted on cardiac auscultation.
Her skin is warm and moist.

encounters.cc: Generalized tonic-clonic seizure lasting approximately 10 minutes at home.

lines: Generalized tonic-clonic seizure lasting approximately 10 minutes at home.
The patient, known for epilepsy and medication noncompliance during prior endocrinology and psychiatry encounters, presents with a prolonged seizure.
Her husband reports that the seizure lasted approximately 10 minutes before spontaneously resolving.
The patient has been noncompliant with her medication regimen for the past two months.
Her husband is concerned about the risk of permanent brain injury.
- Major depressive disorder with psychotic features (diagnosed 2020-03-15)
She has a history of epilepsy.
- Emtricitabine/Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate 200 mg/300 mg PO daily
Smoking: Former smoker, quit 3 years ago.
Her temperature is 37.2°C (99.0°F), blood pressure is 130/85 mmHg, pulse is 88/min, and respiratory rate is 16/min.
On examination, the patient is postictal, drowsy, and confused.
Neurological examination reveals mild right-sided weakness.
- Complete blood count: within normal limits
An urgent head CT scan shows no acute hemorrhage or mass effect.
An EEG shows diffuse slowing without evidence of epileptiform discharges.

encounters.cc: Three-day history of dizziness, headache, nausea, and electric shock sensations after stopping sertraline.

lines: Three-day history of dizziness, headache, nausea, and electric shock sensations after stopping sertraline.

This patient with major depressive disorder and prior antidepressant discontinuation returns to the emergency department with a 3-day history of dizziness, headache, nausea, and "electric shock" sensations.
She reports feeling anxious and describes a sensation of her heart racing.
- Major depressive disorder with psychotic features (diagnosed 2020-03-15)
Her medical history is significant for major depressive disorder,.
She takes for which she was taking sertraline 100 mg daily until one week ago when she ran out of her medication and decided to stop taking it.
- Emtricitabine/Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate 200 mg/300 mg PO daily
Smoking: Former smoker, quit 3 years ago.
She denies any recent illness, fever, or use of other medications.
Her vital signs are as follows: blood pressure 130/85 mmHg, heart rate 102 beats per minute, respiratory rate 18 breaths per minute, and temperature 98.6°F (37°C).
Physical examination is unremarkable except for mild tremor in her hands.
An ECG shows sinus tachycardia with no other abnormalities.

encounters.cc: Sudden onset of tonic-clonic seizures at 36 weeks gestation with severe headaches and blurred vision.

lines: Sudden onset of tonic-clonic seizures at 36 weeks gestation with severe headaches and blurred vision.
This patient with epilepsy and status epilepticus in 2021 presents at 36 weeks gestation.
She presents to the emergency department with a sudden onset of tonic-clonic seizures.
Her husband reports that she has been complaining of severe headaches and blurred vision for the past two days.
- Major depressive disorder with psychotic features (diagnosed 2020-03-15)
- Emtricitabine/Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate 200 mg/300 mg PO daily
Smoking: Former smoker, quit 3 years ago.
On examination, her blood pressure is 170/110 mmHg, and
She has 3+ proteinuria on a urine dipstick test.
Reflexes are brisk, and there is mild edema in her lower extremities.

encounters.cc: Recurrent tonic-clonic seizures one month postpartum with persistent headache and visual changes.

lines: Recurrent tonic-clonic seizures one month postpartum with persistent headache and visual changes.
Her husband reports that she has been complaining of a persistent headache and blurred vision for the past two days.
- Major depressive disorder with psychotic features (diagnosed 2020-03-15)
- Emtricitabine/Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate 200 mg/300 mg PO daily
Smoking: Former smoker, quit 3 years ago.
On examination, her blood pressure is 160/110 mmHg
There is 2+ proteinuria on a urine dipstick test.
Reflexes are brisk, and there is mild edema in her lower extremities.

encounters.cc: Irregular vaginal bleeding and postcoital spotting for two months with unintentional weight loss and fatigue.

lines: Irregular vaginal bleeding and postcoital spotting for two months with unintentional weight loss and fatigue.
This 37-year-old with HIV and eclampsia history presents.
She has not been compliant with her antiretroviral therapy and reports unintentional weight loss and fatigue.
- Major depressive disorder with psychotic features (diagnosed 2020-03-15)
- Emtricitabine/Tenofovir disoproxil fumarate 200 mg/300 mg PO daily
Smoking: Former smoker, quit 3 years ago.
Her vital signs are within normal limits.
On physical examination, a painless ulcerative lesion is noted on the cervix.
Palpation of the inguinal region reveals bilateral painless lymphadenopathy.
A pelvic examination confirms the presence of a cervical lesion
The patient's most recent laboratory results are as follows:
- Human papillomavirus (HPV) DNA test: Positive for HPV type 18
